model.pretraining: DINO self-supervised on ImageNet-1k, without class labels

selection: best validation macro-F1; first epoch wins ties
early_stopping: 5 epochs without a strict improvement in validation loss
test_policy: No test images or predictions in 07
fine_tuning: not implemented or enabled: requires a separate decision after measuring cost
sampling: all eligible train/validation; no automatic cap or class balancing
